summary:
AstroYuvan: Learn, Design, and Play Space Missions

AstroYuvan is an educational web platform that combines space learning with interactive gaming to make STEM education engaging and accessible for students. The platform features astronomy and space science learning modules alongside a Space Gaming Zone powered by Scratch-based games.

For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, AstroYuvan helps learners understand space mission design through hands-on, game-based experiences. Players explore concepts such as rover operations, rocket missions, asteroid defense, resource management, navigation, and mission planning while making decisions that influence mission outcomes.

By blending educational content with interactive gameplay, AstroYuvan encourages critical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, and systems thinking. The platform transforms complex space concepts into fun learning experiences, enabling students to think like scientists, engineers, and mission planners.

Our goal is to inspire the next generation of space innovators by providing an engaging environment where users can learn, experiment, and explore the challenges of space exploration through play.

Website: www.astroyuvan.com
details:
Project Details www.astroyuvan.com

What does it do and how does it work?

AstroYuvan is a web-based learning and gaming platform that combines space education with interactive gameplay. Users can explore astronomy and space science concepts through learning modules and then apply their knowledge in Scratch-based games such as Mars rover exploration, rocket missions, and asteroid-defense challenges. The platform encourages users to make mission-related decisions, solve problems, and understand how different choices affect mission outcomes.

What benefits does it have?

AstroYuvan makes complex space and STEM concepts easy to understand through hands-on learning. It improves critical thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, and creativity while keeping students engaged through gamified experiences.

What is the intended impact?

Our goal is to inspire the next generation of scientists, engineers, and space explorers by providing an accessible and enjoyable environment where learners can discover, experiment, and develop an interest in space exploration.

What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software were used?

  • Scratch for game development - yuvandeo on Scratch
  • VS Code with ASP .NET MVC framework for the website
  • Web-based hosting and deployment tools - Microsoft Azure
  • GoDaddy for Domain
  • Standard computers and web browsers for development and testing
  • AI Tools like Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini

How is your project creative?

AstroYuvan uniquely combines space education and gaming on a single platform. Instead of only reading about space, users actively learn through interactive games that simulate real-world space exploration concepts in a fun and accessible way.

  • 🚀 Atmosphere Journey (Journey through different atmospheres)
  • 🔴 Mars Rover (rover mission gameplay)
  • 🛡️ Asteroid Invasion (Game to destroy asteroids)
  • 🔴 Star Connect (Connect stars in constellation)

What factors did your team consider?

Our team focused on educational value, accessibility, ease of use, engagement, age-appropriate learning, scientific accuracy, creativity, and encouraging curiosity about space. We also considered how to make STEM learning enjoyable for beginners while introducing real mission-planning and exploration concepts.
